description: She wears an opaque plum floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Gold-toned woven geometric and floral borders frame the neckline, shoulder bands, sleeves, vertical front and hem. A cream underdress shows through the modest below-knee walking opening. A cream wrap with plum-and-gold patterned borders rests across her forearms and hangs down each side. A narrow decorated gold-toned belt, two round shoulder brooches, drop earrings, a small round pendant necklace and bracelet are visible. Plum leather shoe toes bear gold-toned embroidered motifs. No headgear or weapon is visible.
